in_marathi.name: Nimrit
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Victory
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nimrit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Goddess of victory, Nimrita, is a form of Durga. Her name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Nimrita', which means 'setting free from', 'delivering from', or 'liberating'. She is often depicted as a beautiful woman riding a lion and wielding a bow and arrow. Nimrita is the goddess of justice and protects her devotees from their enemies. She is also known as the goddess of the stars and is believed to control the cycles of birth and death.
